title: BitSparse: Compact Activation Storage for ReLU Feed-Forward Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22256v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reducing memory use in large language model (LLM) training is an ongoing challenge. Activation checkpointing saves memory by recomputation, while lossy compression changes the stored activations. The reemergence of sparse $\relu$ and $\relu^2$ activations creates a third opportunity: losslessly compressing the activation cache itself. We present BitSparse, a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse activations. Compression and reconstruction run in custom Triton kernels fused into an autograd function, shrinking the activation cache while recovering it exactly for the backward pass. Bfloat16 (BF16) and FP8 activations are supported. Optional sign-bit packing further increases compression up to close to the theoretical limit. We analyze its compression ratio and compare it to the theoretical optimum. BitSparse lowers per-token VRAM by 31\% and 30\% Modded-NanoGPT and Nemotron-H respectively, with overheads of no more than 1\% a

translated_title: BitSparse：面向 ReLU 前馈网络的紧凑激活存储
translated_abstract: 降低大语言模型（LLM）训练中的内存使用是一个持续的挑战。激活检查点通过重计算来节省内存，而有损压缩则会改变存储的激活值。稀疏 ReLU 和 ReLU² 激活的重新出现带来了第三种机会：对激活缓存本身进行无损压缩。我们提出了 BitSparse，一种面向稀疏激活的 GPU 常驻无损压缩格式。压缩与重建运行在融合进自动求导函数的自定义 Triton 内核中，在缩减激活缓存的同时为反向传播精确恢复激活值。该方法支持 Bfloat16（BF16）和 FP8 激活。可选的符号位打包进一步将压缩率提升至接近理论极限。我们分析了其压缩比，并与理论最优值进行了比较。BitSparse 分别将 Modded-NanoGPT 和 Nemotron-H 的每 token 显存占用降低了 31% 和 30%，且开销不超过 1%。
tldr: BitSparse 利用稀疏 ReLU 激活特性实现 GPU 上的无损激活压缩，通过融合进自动求导的自定义 Triton 内核，将 Modded-NanoGPT 和 Nemotron-H 的每 token 显存占用分别降低 31% 和 30%，且开销不超过 1%。
en_tdlr: BitSparse is a GPU-resident lossless compression format for sparse ReLU activations, implemented as custom Triton kernels fused into autograd, that reduces per-token VRAM by 31% on Modded-NanoGPT and 30% on Nemotron-H with overheads of no more than 1%.
